name: ecb_get_series
description:
Time series for any ECB statistical series, by dataflow and series key or by a shorthand indicator.
Returns: flow, key, series_name (the ECB title), description, unit, unit_multiplier, frequency, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first; a note when the period has no observations.
Inputs: flow and key together (e.g. flow EXR, key D.USD.EUR.SP00.A; other flows: HICP, MNA, BSI, LFSI) or indicator (shorthand such as eur_usd, ester, bond_10y, hicp_overall, gdp, m3; list in the schema); one form is needed; start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY); recent_periods (1-100; default 10; the last N observations of the series whatever its frequency, used only when neither date is given).
Shorthands and their keys: ecb_search_series; one value: ecb_get_latest.
Example: {"indicator": "hicp_core", "start_date": "2023-01-01", "end_date": "2024-12-31"}

flow.description: ECB data flow identifier (e.g., 'EXR' for exchange rates, 'FM' for financial markets, 'HICP' for inflation)

key.description: ECB series key (e.g., 'D.USD.EUR.SP00.A' for USD/EUR daily)

indicator.description: Common indicator shorthand name for convenience

recent_periods.description: Number of most recent observations to retrieve (1-100). Used when start_date and end_date are not specified.

description.description: Detailed description of the data series

examples.description: Get main refinancing rate for date range
